name: reservation-platform
description: Backend modules, API host, SDK, React hooks, UI components, and examples for a modular booking platform.

scripts.build: pnpm run packages:build && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/standalone-api-skeleton run build
scripts.packages:build: pnpm --filter @project-play/reservations-core run build && pnpm --filter @project-play/reservation-chat-core run build && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/contract-types run build && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/platform-config run build && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/ai-chat run build && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/whatsapp run build && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/api run build && pnpm --filter @project-play/reservations-supabase run build && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/database run build && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/sdk run build && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/react run build && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/ui run build
scripts.packages:test: pnpm --filter @project-play/reservations-core run test && pnpm --filter @project-play/reservation-chat-core run test && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/contract-types run test && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/platform-config run test && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/ai-chat run test && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/whatsapp run test && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/api run test && pnpm --filter @project-play/reservations-supabase run test && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/database run test && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/sdk run test && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/react run test && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/ui run test
scripts.packages:pack: pnpm --filter @project-play/reservations-core pack --pack-destination dist-packages && pnpm --filter @project-play/reservation-chat-core pack --pack-destination dist-packages && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/ai-chat pack --pack-destination dist-packages && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/whatsapp pack --pack-destination dist-packages && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/contract-types pack --pack-destination dist-packages && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/platform-config pack --pack-destination dist-packages && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/api pack --pack-destination dist-packages && pnpm --filter @project-play/reservations-supabase pack --pack-destination dist-packages && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/database pack --pack-destination dist-packages && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/sdk pack --pack-destination dist-packages && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/react pack --pack-destination dist-packages && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/ui pack --pack-destination dist-packages
scripts.backend-platform:verify-standalone-api-s: pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/api run build && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/contract-types run build && pnpm --filter @reservation-platform/standalone-api-skeleton run test
scripts.test: pnpm run packages:test && pnpm run backend-platform:verify-standalone-api-skeleton && pnpm run database:verify-migration-bundle
